## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 173 captures during June 2022. Activity was monitored through the month, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that imaging services continued according to the site’s usual arrangements. No operational issue beyond routine leave is identified in the reporting information.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. There was 1 ungradable capture, giving an ungradable rate of 0.6. This represents a limited proportion of the month’s activity. The ungradable examination should be considered in routine quality monitoring and follow-up.

## Grading

A total of 38 results were graded referable. The median lag for grading was 24 days. This provides the central measure of the time between capture and completion of grading for the month. The results should be reviewed alongside the activity and image-quality measures to support ongoing oversight of site performance.
